question: What optimal operating conditions were identified for the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation, and what purities and recoveries did they give?
expect: 10 kPa, 16 theoretical plates, feed on tray 11, mass reflux ratio 3.143, D/F 0.092; HQ purity 99.2%, CAT purity 99%, HQ recovery 98.5%, CAT recovery 97.8% (abstract)
rendered:
The optimal operating conditions were identified as 10 kPa operating pressure, reflux ratio of 3.143, and feed stage at the 11th tray.

Under these conditions, the overhead catechol purity reached 0.99, while bottoms hydroquinone purity achieved 0.992. Corresponding recovery rates were 98.5% (catechol) and 97.8% (hydroquinone), with a reboiler heat duty of 12.175 kW.

These results represent improvements of 16.8% in catechol purity, 1.8% in hydroquinone purity, and 19.3% in energy efficiency (reduction in specific energy consumption from 0.152 to 0.124 kWh/kg) compared to initial simulation conditions.
